unlisted_practices: Orchestrator-specialist multi-agent architecture with domain-specialized agents for diagnostic reasoning
Clinical practice guideline-based prompting versus question-based prompting
Structured, evidence-grounded rationales from each agent for interpretable diagnosis

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an orchestrator multi-agent LLM system compared to single-LLM baselines and prompt variations on clinical vignettes, focusing on model architecture and prompt design rather than an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
